text:
- [RARC.3.6.3] **Multi-tier deployment.** One tier per
  source for tight-latency per-source decisions
  feeding an orchestration tier for cross-source
  state, optionally feeding a site-level tier for
  cross-deployment orchestration. A process
  boundary splits the tier tree wherever
  independent restart or remote topology matters;
  integrator-side transport carries
  `ACTION_PUBLISH` payloads across.
